text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in a thread on their #central-random message: the ticket number is **#88412**.

That's the Tier 2 escalation for Tansleigh Packaging, where the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 froze on the BOL barcode scan. Tobias posted it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025. He said it seemed to happen when Quarendon Freightways drivers arrived with split manifests. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so this was theirs to see.

The share has no ticket files for Tansleigh, so I couldn't check whether the ticket is still open. The number comes only from that Slack conversation.
